rationale.hitl-workflow: Human approval required at baselines and deployments via preview environments.
rationale.ai-review: QA agent uses LLMs to generate tests from requirements.
rationale.rules-based-checks: QA agent enforces CI quality gates and runs generated tests.
rationale.provenance-auditability: Maintains decision logs and audit trails for human transparency.
rationale.risk-quality: Reports empirical reductions in defect density and product rework.
rationale.steering: System automates requirement generation, planning, and task allocation workflows.
